News - TC Harrison joins KGM dealer network with new Stamford site

TC Harrison joins KGM dealer network with new Stamford site

August 28, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:56
Instaread

KGM Motors UK has appointed TC Harrison to its dealer network, with the family-owned retailer opening a new KGM showroom in Stamford, Lincolnshire.

The new dealership, located on Wharf Road, will sell the complete KGM passenger car and commercial vehicle range, including the Musso pick-up and new electric Musso EV.

TC Harrison was established in 1931 by Thomas ‘Cuth’ Harrison and has grown from a service and repair business into a major multi-site vehicle retailer. The company remains owned and operated by the Harrison family.

The addition of KGM to its Stamford operation gives the manufacturer increased representation across Lincolnshire and surrounding areas.

Read our KGM Rexton Commercial review

As well as new vehicle sales, the dealership will provide KGM aftersales support including servicing and maintenance, MOT testing, accident repair support and genuine parts and accessories.

The commercial vehicle offering includes the established Musso diesel pick-up as well as the new Musso EV, KGM’s first fully electric pick-up.

The Musso EV represents a significant expansion of KGM’s pick-up offering, combining an electric powertrain with a double-cab body and giving the manufacturer an alternative to its conventionally powered Musso range.

Simon Oakley, Regional Head of Sales Southern at TC Harrison, said: “We’re all very excited to join the KGM dealer network. It is an exciting new chapter for us at TC Harrison, and a partnership we will both benefit from.

“We look forward to introducing our customers to the quality, capability and value of the KGM range backed by the service and support we’re known for.”

Kevin Griffin, Managing Director at KGM Motors UK, added: “We’re delighted to welcome TC Harrison to KGM. Their heritage, family ownership and strong reputation for customer care make them an excellent partner for the brand.

“With their Stamford KGM showroom, more customers across the region can now experience the KGM line-up with the confidence of expert support before, during and long after purchase.”

Written by: George Barrow
